prompts: Explore Editorial Spread. Add root class pilot-EditorialSpread. Keep the full-screen background film and existing navigation. Move the hero title grouping to a deliberate left-aligned lower-third with generous negative space, using the existing typography, keeping both bottom entry links clear. Below it, create a strong magazine hierarchy: the existing house introduction and route directory have different visual weight; the journal's FIRST existing story becomes a wide lead image/text spread, with the next three arranged as a paced, asymmetric but aligned continuation. Treat the existing two opinions as an editorial pause, not identical boxed cards. Make the contact ending feel intentional. On mobile use a calm readable sequence with controlled varying image proportions. Keep all four stories and every paragraph; no added sections. This is a controlled refinement of the corrected CURRENT La Mesa draft version 2, not a new restaurant template. Preserve the EXACT existing HTML text, data-fact-id, data-media-usage, all eleven data-pilot-media keys, all links, details/summary, disclosures, header and footer. Do not shorten ANY text including hidden story paragraphs. No new content, facts, ratings, Instagram posts, real restaurant claims or operational booking/order functions. No external assets, requests, fonts, icon libraries, scripts or imagery. Preserve the source's neutral media rectangles unchanged; licensed media will be restored only in the local 101 comparison. Keep media pixels unedited and all existing media elements intact. Use original Georgia display + Arial body and white/ink palette. You may only add the requested reusable operator class to the existing .experience-site root and one clearly marked <style id="pilot-variation-css"> block at the END. Put ALL intentional design changes in this override block, scoped to the operator class. Copy the original HTML and existing CSS unchanged before that block. Responsive at 1440x1000 and 390x844; no overlaps, clipped words, hidden content or horizontal overflow; text remains readable over the hero. Dedicated routes stay dedicated. Preserve the exact text-only La Mesa wordmark, all demonstration labels, linked credits and Pixabay non-endorsement. No masks, filters, rotations, blend modes or CSS URL assets on photos or video. Use ONLY the fonts, colors, spacing, and component styles defined in the design system. Do not introduce any fonts, colors, or visual styles not in the design system.

Create alignment and rhythm through columns, image proportions, white space and typographic scale within the existing system. Let the pair of opinions occupy one strong horizontal reading pause, then end with a broad contact/social composition.
